hook.name: Algebra Aggregator Hook
hook.description: Aggregator hook that routes all Uniswap v4 swaps to external Algebra DEX liquidity. The v4 pool holds no liquidity; beforeSwap executes the trade on the registered Algebra pool and returns a delta. Supports Uniswap protocol fees; liquidity addition is blocked. The owner registers DEX sources and pools via addSource and beforeInitialize.
